reuse_rule: May analyse the same future confirmatory acquisition only if this PACC mapping, thresholds and decision rule are publicly frozen before any confirmatory datum. It is a parallel registered analysis, not a post-hoc reinterpretation.
independent_unit: same physical independent unit/blocking structure as MAG-PAIR-001
X_anchor: pre-intervention vector-remanence response summary, measured before active AF ablation and before the future challenge readout
m_intervention: AF demagnetization at the pilot-frozen plateau reducing the trace by >=80%; sham follows MAG-PAIR-001

challenge_design.rule: challenge amplitude(s) and orientation(s) must be selected from sacrificial pilot data and frozen before confirmatory acquisition; no confirmatory outcome may tune them

response_dimensions: projection of remanence on the frozen challenge-field axis

materiality_thresholds.rule: one positive threshold per response dimension, fixed from instrument precision plus scientific SESOI using sacrificial pilot specimens only

decision_rule.causal_qualified: same PACC-INT-CHALLENGE-V1 rule: all matching flags true and preregistered sham passes
decision_rule.causal_effect_nonzero: paired bootstrap 95% interval for Delta_P_acc excludes 0

cross_branch_rule: Condition XIV-11 is targeted only if VES-PACC-INT-01 and PACC-MAG-INT-01 both qualify under the same definition_id and same causal decision rule before results; domain-specific raw response dimensions are not numerically equated.
